decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting assertions regarding the construction date of the Bonner House. Document 1 (D1S2) explicitly states 'It was built about 1835'. Document 2 (D2S1 and D2S3) explicitly states 'Built about 1935' and 'It was built about 1935'. As per the instructions to preserve distinct valid referents and not collapse multi-answer questions when sources provide competing assertions, both dates are retained as they represent distinct claims found in the source material.
